BiblicalUsage: Sklerotes is hardness, the callousness of a heart that will not turn, and it appears once, where Paul says the man after his hardness and impenitent heart treasures up wrath against the day of wrath.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe hardness stores up wrath the way a miser stores up gold, and the day of reckoning pays it all out at once.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
